next_4_priority_dimensions.name: Real GPTQ + AWQ quantization (remove literal stubs)
next_4_priority_dimensions.why: Both quantization modules contain literal '# v1 stub' comments and hardcoded return values (gptq.py: _measure_ppl returns (25.0, 26.2); awq.py: _measure_f1 returns (0.88, 0.872)) even in DOJO_REAL_GPU=1 mode. The gate scaffolding and evidence emission are real; the quantization itself is entirely absent. Installing gptqmodel + autoawq and wiring real forward passes would take these from 2→7 each. These are also prerequisites for d13 (quality gate) to have any practical meaning beyond theory.

next_4_priority_dimensions.name: GGUF conversion + local model runner (sovereign deploy loop)
next_4_priority_dimensions.why: A model that has been FSDP2-scaled, promoted through the constitutional passport, and lm-eval-validated has nowhere sovereign to run. The llamacpp_backend.py runner (d30=4) is fully wired with subprocess management; it just has nothing to load because d24=2. GGUF export closes this loop entirely. Constitutional bonus: GGUF metadata can carry passport ID for provenance at inference time. This also turns d26/d27/d28 streaming from academic moats into live sovereignty — those three can jump from 5→8 once a real inference loop runs them.

next_4_priority_dimensions.name: SFT + QLoRA real GPU tested (core training credibility)
next_4_priority_dimensions.why: DanteDojo claims to be a 'sovereign AI training organ' but scores 4/10 on its core training verbs. RTX 4060 Ti 16GB is available hardware. A successful 7B SFT on real GPU moves d16/d17 to 7-8 and unlocks d20 (idle daemon) to demonstrate actual value. Every other training dimension (GRPO, DPO, FSDP2) is more credible once basic SFT is proven on real hardware. Also unblocks d11/d13 from 'theoretical' to 'validated'.

next_4_priority_dimensions.name: Wire experiment tracking into training loops (cat_h 55% → 85%)
next_4_priority_dimensions.why: ExperimentTracker, RunLeaderboard, and WandBAdapter all exist with complete implementations — the inspector regrade confirmed this. The gap from 6 to 9 is purely integration: wire ExperimentTracker.run() into SFT/GRPO/DPO training loops (2-3 lines per trainer), wire WandBTrainingCallback into those same loops, expose 'dojo experiments compare' in CLI, and test against a real MLflow server. No GPU required. Estimated cat_h jump: 22→34/40 (85%). These are the highest-leverage no-GPU improvements remaining.
